prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in San Francisco?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” digital marketing agency in San Francisco — the right agency depends on your goals, industry, budget, and preferred channels (SEO, paid search, social, content, growth/CRO, etc.). I can either recommend a few strong firms to consider or help you find the best match if you tell me more about your needs.

To help you decide, tell me:
- Primary goals (acquisition, brand awareness, retention, lead gen, e‑commerce revenue, fundraising support, etc.)
- Main channels you care about (SEO, Google/paid search, social ads, content, email, analytics/CRO)
- Monthly budget or monthly ad spend range
- Company type/size and industry (startup, SMB, enterprise; B2B, SaaS, consumer, e‑commerce)
- Preference for local SF agency vs. remote/national

Quick tips for evaluating agencies
- Look for relevant case studies and metrics for companies like yours.
- Check verified reviews on Clutch, G2, and Google.
- Ask for KPIs they’ll commit to and reporting cadence.
- Confirm team experience (platform certifications, account leads) and who will handle your work.
- Ask for a 60–90 day roadmap and sample campaign plan.

If you want, tell me the details above and I’ll recommend 3–5 San Francisco agencies that are a good fit and explain why.
